text: Unning $60 per hour from Kenya means nothing, a 15% of every payment disappears in transfer fees and three weeks pass between invoice and bank deposit. Setting up the right payment infrastructure once saves you thousands of shillings per year. In this lesson, receiving international payments in Kenya has four options, each with different fee structures, speeds and reliability. Peonia, a digital payment platform that gives you a US, EU and UK virtual bank account. Clients pay your virtual bank account directly via ACH or SEPA, same as paying a US or UK contractor. Fees, receiving from clients directly, free or 0.50-3 per transfer, depending on method, receiving from platforms, Upwork, Amazon, Airbnb, 1% of payment. Withdrawing to Kenyon Bank in KES, 2% currency conversion, plus $1.50 withdrawal fee. Peonia is the standard choice for Upwork and most freelance platforms. It is what most Kenyon professionals use first. Wise, formally transfer wise, gives you virtual bank accounts in 10 plus currencies, best for receiving GBP, UK clients, EUR, EU clients and USD. Fees, receiving is usually free. currency conversion at the mid-market rate plus small fee, 0.4-1.1% depending on currency pair. Withdrawing to Kenyon Bank, 250 Kenyon shillings plus exchange rate fee. Wise is typically 3-5 times cheaper than bank wire transfers for the same transaction. Recommended for clients who prefer to pay via bank transfer rather than platforms. Upwork payment flow. Upwork withholds 20% of your first $500 with each client, then 10% up to $10,000, then 5% above $10,000. These are platform fees, not currency fees. Payment to Peonia is instant when client releases funds. Peonia to Kenyon Bank takes 2-5 business days. Direct bank wire. Some clients prefer international wire transfer. Your Kenyon Bank swift code enables incoming international wires. Fees, receiving bank charges 15-25 dollars per incoming wire. Your bank plus sending fees 25-40 dollars charged by clients bank. Total friction. 40-65 dollars per transfer. For large payments, $5,000 plus, this is acceptable. For small payments, $200-500, the fees are prohibitive. Use Peonia or Wise instead. KRA tax obligations. Freelance income earned from international clients is taxable income in Kenyon. Register for a KRA PIN if you do not have one. Report income in your annual tax return. If your annual income from freelancing exceeds 1.5 million Kenyon shillings, you are required to register for VAT. Keep records of all client invoices and payment receipts. Apply what you learn in this lesson and you will see results immediately. Your skills bear fruit.
